topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: Dynamically changing flight formations present unique challenges for maintaining consistent Line-of-Sight (LOS) connectivity.  Adaptive beamforming, leveraging Channel State Information (CSI), is crucial for mitigating frequency-selective fading caused by aircraft velocity and unpredictable mobility patterns.  Optimizing beam spacing, adjusting phase shift based on channel conditions through CSI feedback mechanisms, and employing routing protocols that leverage GPS timing coordination are key to achieving reliable communication in dynamic flight formations. This approach minimizes interference from neighboring aircraft and ground-based radars, ensuring stable connectivity even under challenging conditions.
